title: Typography Don’ts
slide_intent: Make failures of hierarchy and contrast recognizable so readers can retain the intended message.
strategic_value: Avoiding competing styles and obscured subjects can make T-Mobile communications clearer and more coherent.
demonstration: Eight rejected specimens show misplaced emphasis, mixed styles, light weights, uneven tracking, face obstruction, low contrast, weak hierarchy and italics.
practical_value: Check the main reading order, image subject and contrast before approving a type composition.
